The '''2015–16 New Zealand Football Championship''' season (currently known as the ''ASB Premiership''  for sponsorship reasons) is the twelfth season of the NZFC since its establishment in 2004. Eight teams are involved this season, after [[Wanderers Special Club|Wanderers SC]] withdrew from the competition.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nzfootball.co.nz/asb-premiership-draw-revealed/|title=ASB Premiership draw revealed|publisher=[[New Zealand Football]]|date=9 September 2015|access-date=2015-10-05|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151006184036/http://www.nzfootball.co.nz/asb-premiership-draw-revealed/|archive-date=2015-10-06|url-status=dead}}</ref> [[Auckland City FC|Auckland City]] and [[Team Wellington]] will represent the ASB Premiership in the [[2016 OFC Champions League]] after finishing Champions and Runners-up respectively in the [[2014–15 ASB Premiership|2014–15]] competition.

===Fixtures and results===
The 2015–16 season sees every team play the other both home and away. Due to Auckland City's participation in the [[2015 FIFA Club World Cup]], several matches have been rescheduled.<ref>{{cite web|title=2015–16 ASB Premiership Draw|url=http://www.nzfootball.co.nz/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/ASB-Premiership-Draw-2015-16.jpg|publisher=[[New Zealand Football]]|accessdate=6 October 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151007032945/http://www.nzfootball.co.nz/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/ASB-Premiership-Draw-2015-16.jpg|archive-date=7 October 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nzfootball.co.nz/asb-premiership-fixtures/|title=2015–16 fixtures and results|publisher=[[New Zealand Football]]|accessdate=6 October 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151006101407/http://www.nzfootball.co.nz/asb-premiership-fixtures/|archive-date=6 October 2015|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}}</ref>
